name: Fishers' Flotilla
description: Fishing boats lashed together into a floating village. Nets dry on the masts; the fishers sell what the sea gives and share their hearth.

name: Raft Camp
description: A ring of rafts tied to an anchored hulk, with a brazier on deck that never quite goes out.

name: Dune Village
description: Sand-walkers trade under striped awnings, their camels resting in the shade.

name: Last Camp
description: The final shelter before the storm. A grim trader sells to those who still dare.
